title: Expedition Complete
text: The hall, the rail and the booth are mapped and sent home. The cradles are empty and warm. On the Gantry's card a route has appeared out past Nereid, to Teth, where the relay's last carrier ends. And at home the log has started writing lines a moment before you do.

choices.label: Return to Touchdown
choices.reply: The lander lifts off the black rock. Behind it the cradles stay warm, as if somebody meant to use them again soon.

choices.label: Stay a while
choices.reply: The expedition stays. The Command Core's card lists every route, home included, for when we're ready.

notes: onDone of foundry. Home is where the Clause wakes (clause-6, then clause-wakes); Teth (long-ear) is optional.
